The climate in Brașov

Brașov is about 590 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 25°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −6°C. Around 840 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 122 mm).

Best time to visit Brașov

The most pleasant weather in Brașov is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 21°C and 25°C, with up to 15 days of rain a month. In January and February nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
